text:
ravi: quick thought 95 what if the edge had a single, well-documented degraded path for midstream failures: on upstream timeout/error, abort streaming and return either a cached snapshot or a single final payload from a retry attempt. simpler than lease-transfer and much easier on engineers.

maya: sounds pragmatic. main risk is UX for streaming-first clients. they expect incremental tokens.

ravi: agreed. plan is to tag routes with degrade_policy: {mode: "single_payload", allow_cache: true/false}. streaming routes for premium customers stay on resume.

tom: what about EXACT semantics for side-effects? if the backend already started tool calls, re-running could cause duplicates.

ravi: require idempotency header for any request with side-effects. if absent we can't rerun 95 fallback becomes an error reply explaining why.

anya: small detail: cached snapshot option is great for deterministic prompts (embeddings/search pipelines). need TTL rules and a cache-bypass header.

ravi: yep: X-Edge-Fallback: cache|rerun|error. default order: cache -> rerun -> error. and we emit X-Edge-Degraded: true so clients/SDKs can surface.

tom: implementation sketch (edge proxy pseudocode):
```
if upstream.stream_error and route.degrade_policy == 'single_payload':
  emit_sse(client, {"degraded":true})
  close_upstream_stream()
  if cache.exists(req.key) and route.allow_cache:
    resp = cache.get(req.key)
  else if req.headers.get('Idempotency-Key'):
    resp = backend.call_nonstream(req.with_idempotency())
  else:
    resp = error_body('degraded: cannot rerun without idempotency')
  send_single_chunk(client, resp.body)
```

maya: neat. metrics we need: ingress.degraded_count, ingress.degraded_by_route, degraded_cache_hit, degraded_rerun_count, degraded_no_idempotency_count. Also trace span annotated with fallback_reason.

anya: add a tag to billing: mark generation as "degraded_path" so Finance can filter. we should NOT increment successful upstream token billing twice. only count tokens from the final successful run.

anya: tests: unit for path selection, integration simulating partial stream + abort, and e2e that validates client sees SSE {"degraded":true} before single chunk. ops-bot: include config gating for feature flag ingress.degrade.single_payload in staging.

ops-bot: checklist created: update proxy schema, add feature-flag, add metrics + traces, add SDK notice for X-Edge-Degraded, add integration tests.

maya: question: KV prefix cache 95 if we rerun we should bypass prefix KV. set header X-Edge-KV-Bypass: true for rerun. document behavior.

tom: also: add a fallback_trace_id to correlate attempt(s) with original stream for debugging. log at INFO when fallback triggers.

ravi: rollout: 1) land behind flag, 2) canary on non-critical routes for 48h, 3) enable for free/standard tiers, keep enterprise on resume.

anya: UX: SDKs should listen for X-Edge-Degraded and show a short banner "Response degraded to single payload". include example snippet in docs.

maya: +1. I'll write the tiny RFC addendum with config schema, metrics, and a simple diagram contrasting resume vs single_payload.

ravi: thanks. i'll open the PR for proxy + tests. ping @tom for review on idempotency gating.

ops-bot: reminder: add integration test that asserts telemetry increments and ensures no double-billing for reruns.

ravi: target: staging canary next Wed EOD, observe for 72h.
